about.title: About Me
about.bio1: Hello! I'm Victor, a passionate software engineer who loves crafting elegant solutions to complex problems. My journey in programming started back in 2015 when I decided to try building custom themes for a blogging platform — turns out hacking together a custom theme taught me a lot about HTML & CSS!
about.bio2: Fast-forward to today, and I've had the privilege of working at startups, agencies, and large corporations. My main focus these days is building accessible, inclusive products and digital experiences at a large tech company for a variety of clients.
